VICIVISION X5 FLOW

Engineered for fully automated in-line inspection, VICIVISION X5 FLOW enables continuous 100% control of small turned components directly within the production flow. The system combines automated loading-unloading with a non-contact optical measurement system for continuous part handling.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
VICIVISION M625 TECHNO

Designed for large and heavy componentes up to 200 kg, VICIVISION M625 TECHNO guarantees stable, accurate, and repeatable measurements even in demanding industrial environments.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
METRIOS 532 WITH CONFOCAL TECHNOLOGY

Metrios 532 features a large measuring area of 500 × 300 × 200 mm and allows full dimensional inspection of large components. Thanks to the integrated confocal sensor, it enables fast, accurate, non-contact height measurement with no risk of part deformation.
